Server spoke English...
Jan 2020
An overnight in HCM to change planes from Cambodia to USA found us looking for food midday on Monday of the Chinese New Year holiday. It was not the best time to find anything open for lunch. However, we happened upon Com Tam Cali and were pleasantly surprised...not that we had a lot of choices. There was only one other table in use and the staff were in the middle of a shift change. Our server spoke English which was a plus but was about to end her shift. She graciously helped us decipher their menu, suggested food items and stayed to take our orders before clocking out. Our rice noodles, broken rice and chicken rice dishes were quite tasty and only lacking a nice glass of white wine. The restaurant was well-maintained and prices very reasonable. The cost was less than five dollars each which included six bottles of water to go. Happy to have found this place.

Poor Restaurant
Sep 2019 • Family
Food is mediocre. We ordered the #46, #60, #61 and the pumpkin soup. The soup was good. But overall the food lacked. 

The restaurant lost 3 stars due to the following:
1. Their food is edible but it's not great. Pork was hard and cold. Spring rolls were cold and tasted like they were made in the morning - and not freshly made. 
2. This restaurant is NOT clean or hygienic. There were small bugs (ants of some sort crawling on the walls). In the picture you can only see 2, but there was a LINE of them creeping about as we ate.
3. Customer service was horrendous at the end of our meal. The waitress at the till tried to overcharge us. When questioned, she did not apologize. INSTEAD, she gave us atrocious attitude by throwing the change back on the table to us. 

Overall, I would not come back NOR recommend this restaurant to anyone. You can find a better restaurant with better quality food, cleaner atmosphere and more welcoming and kinder customer service. 

TIP: If you come here, they will charge you 10dong for using the towelettes they give you at the beginning of your meal.

Good food but irresponsible staff.
May 2019 • Family
We went to this restaurant to have dinner and that was our last night at Saigon. We ordered items specifying item numbers on Menu card. Later when ordered items came also we repeatedly asked what numbers on Menu they are and lucky that we did. After having food when the bill came, one item was not what we asked for...the price was different. Because we ordered as per Menu item number they could not refute it and reluctantly they corrected it. They put additional 10% VAT on the menu rate. All other places we had dinner during last 3 weeks VAT was part of menu tariff.

Having said that, food was good hence 3 points for it but staff was a big let down.

Food was not bad! Pumpkin soup was tasty!
Dec 2018 • Couples
We were too early for check-in at Fusion Suites Saigon, so we walked around its surrounding to kill time. After visiting the Catholic Church Huyen Sy, we walked past Com Tam Cali. We saw at least 5 tables were occupied on the outer wing, so we thought food must be not bad. (After entering the restaurant, realised there was an inner wing.)

We ordered pho as our mains, mine was pho with Vietnamese Popiah (spring rolls) and my family member ordered pho with tiny shredded meat; pumpkin soup, sugar cane drink and Viet white coffee. We had a few rounds of pumpkin soup in Moscow/St Petersburg in May/June this year and they were cooked in a creamy way while Com Tam Cali’s pumpkin soup is clear soup. We forgot if we had pumpkin soup in Chinese restaurants in Singapore because pumpkin is not our love but Com Tam Cali’s pumpkin soup turned out to be tasty! 

Decor was simple but nice. Interior was cleaner than the non-air-conditioned coffee shops.
